result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the promotional banner text has low contrast and is difficult to read.

issues.description: The white promotional text on the very light mint-green banner has insufficient contrast, making “3 free deliveries for you” and the smaller checkout code text hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text, use a darker overlay on the banner, or choose a higher-contrast background color so the promotion remains clearly legible.
